Layout.Title: MaDemonstrator — settings, about, help and license

Input.label: PRESENTATION WINDOW
Input.tip: Use full, max, normal, or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Up to 160x80 uses grid cells; larger sizes use pixels.

Input.label: HELPER WINDOW
Input.tip: Use none to hide notes, or full, max, normal, or WIDTHxHEIGHT. Up to 160x80 uses cells; larger sizes use pixels.

Layout.Text: MaDemonstrator turns Markdown into presentations while keeping your ideas in focus. Write and refine slides with a live preview, choose a theme, and prepare speaker notes in one place. Present in a dedicated window while your notes stay close at hand.
